Non reentrant for the same Pdu Id. Parameters (in) Rx Pdu Id ID of the received PDU. Pdu Info Ptr Contains the length (Sdu Length) of the received PDU, a pointer to a buffer (Sdu Data Ptr) containing the PDU, and the Meta Data related to this PDU. Available via J1939Tp.h
